summary:
美光EPS狂超預期，HBM與記憶體漲價推升營收近三倍年增。
• EPS 12.20美元，大幅超出預期9.16美元，驚喜幅度33.21%。
• 營收238.6億美元，年增196.29%，反映記憶體強勁漲價循環。
• HBM（高頻寬記憶體）受惠AI伺服器需求，成為高毛利成長引擎。
• DRAM與NAND供需改善，平均售價（ASP）顯著回升。
• 本益比50.69倍，反映市場對AI記憶體需求的高度預期。
ai_view:
訊號強勁正向：營收年增196%與EPS狂超預期，記憶體超級循環與HBM紅利全面兌現。短中期股價受AI伺服器記憶體需求驅動，動能強勁。但記憶體本質為週期股，須警惕循環反轉風險。追蹤指標：HBM出貨占比與簽約量、DRAM/NAND平均售價走勢、產業庫存水位、同業擴產進度。一旦ASP見頂，估值與獲利雙殺風險升高。

需留意：記憶體為週期性產業，漲價循環終將反轉。；競爭對手擴產可能在未來造成供給過剩。；高本益比下，任何需求或定價轉弱訊號將放大波動。

summary_en:
Micron crushes EPS as HBM and memory pricing drive near-tripling revenue growth.
• EPS of $12.20 beat the $9.16 estimate by 33.21%.
• Revenue of $23.86B grew 196.29% YoY amid a strong memory pricing cycle.
• HBM benefits from AI server demand as a high-margin growth engine.
• Improved DRAM and NAND supply-demand lifts average selling prices.
• P/E of 50.69 reflects high expectations for AI memory demand.

ai_view_en:
Signal strongly positive: 196% revenue growth and a huge EPS beat confirm the memory super-cycle and HBM windfall. Near to mid-term, the stock is driven by AI server memory demand with strong momentum. But memory is inherently cyclical, so cycle-reversal risk warrants caution. Track: HBM shipment mix and bookings, DRAM/NAND ASP trends, industry inventory, and peer capacity additions. Once ASPs peak, the risk of a dual valuation-and-earnings hit rises.

Watch：Memory is cyclical; the pricing upcycle will eventually reverse.; Competitor capacity expansion could create future oversupply.; At a high P/E, any demand or pricing weakness amplifies volatility.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+33.21%，營收年增196.29%，記憶體超級循環全面發酵。
